LanguageData.Raven_SpiritEgg.label: [Raven] Spirit Egg
LanguageData.Raven_SpiritEgg.description: A Raven Spirit Egg exuding a warm aura, gestating a new life of the Raven race inside. It must be placed in a specific cradle to hatch.\n\nIf not placed in a cradle, its vital signs will remain in a state of stagnation.
